svg.text: 1. Keep the agent rules and the session commands as plain text

svg.text: files: an agent reads them from the repository it works in,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and shows the difference before anything is kept.

svg.text: identity record, so another team's agents get their own names.
